First post on voat (hello!), testing out the waters in the hopes that this place can be reddit without the shenanigans :).

Per that hope, I've been poking around this sub and came across this post about creating more distance from reddit for the sake of voat becoming its own thing. One of the things mentioned was naming the subverses (see:subreddits) something more different.

To that end, I humbly suggest that we rename the subverses "Voating Blocs". Because it's a pun, and isn't the internet fueled by lame puns and cats??

But more to the point, it gets the name of the site in there like "subreddit", which is just good marketing. Not to mention the definition of a voting bloc (see wiki for a bit more) is "a group of voters that are strongly motivated by a specific common concern or group of concerns..." Which is a damn good definition of a subverse, isn't it?

People are free to quibble about the specifics, but I think it would be a nice way to start further delineating ourselves from reddit. Thoughts?
